$comment: The one list of analytics events (DB-5, Q-P1-20). Edit here, then run `pnpm events:codegen`. A slice that starts emitting an event defines its props first; changing props after first emission bumps that event's version.

session_started.description: A visit began: the first request after 30 minutes without activity (Q-P1-21 return metric).

card_opened.description: A card was opened (Q-P1-21 "opened"). v2 adds the ids, to match opens to finishes (P1-W6-S04). v3 adds where it opened: Interval's in-app reader or the browser (ADR-0018).

section_finished.description: A moment's section was finished (Q-P1-21 "finished"). v2 adds the ids (P1-W6-S04). v3 adds auto: the app's reader saw the section read through (P4-W20-S03).

article_finished.description: A whole-article card was finished. v2 adds the item id (P1-W6-S04). v3 adds auto: its last section finished automatically in the app (P4-W20-S03).

explainer_started.description: A voiced concept explainer began playing on the web or in the app (§5G, P4-W23-S01). Not on a resume of an unfinished listen.

explainer_finished.description: A voiced concept explainer played to its end (§5G, P4-W23-S01).

note_saved.description: A note on a section or an article was written or edited (P2-W7-S03, Q-P2-01). Never the note's text.

quiz_started.description: A quiz started: Test 60s on a section or a whole article (P2-W9-S01, Q-P2-14), or a review session (P2-W9-S05, Q-P2-17). Version 2 adds kind; a review has no item.

quiz_answered.description: A quiz question was answered in time, first time only (P2-W9-S01). ms: from serving to answering.

quiz_finished.description: A Test 60s sprint was finished, once per attempt (P2-W9-S01).

game_started.description: A quick game started on Play (P3-W13-S02, §6.3), once per attempt. Ids only. Version 2 adds estimation (P3-W13-S04); version 3 the daily challenge (P3-W13-S05).

game_finished.description: A quick game finished, once per attempt, on the page or closed when the next one started (P3-W13-S02). points is the score: a sprint's correct count; an estimation round's points, up to 100 an answer (C-27), whose correct counts answers at full points; the daily challenge's, 100 a right choice plus its estimates' points. Version 2 adds estimation and points (P3-W13-S04); version 3 the daily challenge (P3-W13-S05).

estimate_answered.description: An estimation question was answered in time, first time only (P3-W13-S04). points: 0 to 100 (C-27); ms: from serving to answering.

question_flagged.description: A user flagged a question they answered, once per question (P2-W9-S07, Q-2, Q-P2-18). For the under-2% metric.

path_started.description: A user started (or resumed) a topic path, making it their active one (P2-W10-S03, Q-P2-27, Q-P2-28).

path_paused.description: A user's active path was paused: by them, or by their starting another (P2-W10-S05, Q-P2-23, Q-P2-28).

path_section_skipped.description: A user skipped a section of their path: no practiced credit, the next sections open (P2-W10-S05, Q-P2-23, Q-P2-28). Version 2 adds reason: from Edit mode (user), or a mastered section's suggestion (mastered, P2-W10-S07, Q-P2-29).

book_uploaded.description: A user uploaded a PDF book, stored privately and queued for processing (P2-W11-S01, §5F).

book_session_finished.description: A user marked a session of their book done, once per session (P2-W11-S04, §5F).

book_opened.description: The reader showed a session of the user's book: every render, a reload included (P2-W11-S05, §5F).

book_deleted.description: A user deleted one of their books, its file and rows (P2-W11-S01).

checkpoint_started.description: A checkpoint on a path section started, once per attempt (P2-W10-S04, Q-P2-26, Q-P2-28).

checkpoint_finished.description: A checkpoint was finished, once per attempt (P2-W10-S04, Q-P2-26, Q-P2-28). passed: it reached its pass mark (4 of 5; all but one of a smaller one).

book_checkpoint_started.description: A checkpoint on a chapter of the user's book started, once per attempt (P2-W11-S06, Q-P2-35).

book_checkpoint_finished.description: A book chapter's checkpoint was finished, once per attempt (P2-W11-S06, Q-P2-35). passed: it reached its pass mark.

github_connected.description: A user connected GitHub: the App's installations they can reach, by GitHub's own answer (P2-W12-S01, §5H, ADR-0024).

github_disconnected.description: A user disconnected GitHub; Interval's copy of their GitHub data is deleted (P2-W12-S01).

reason_reported.description: A user said one of a card's "Shown for" reasons is wrong (ADR-0026).

item_saved.description: An item was saved (W4-S07; listed by the W5-S04 Library).

feedback_undone.description: Not interested undone right after it was given (W4-S07).

signup_completed.description: An account was made: by joining with an invite code (ADR-0016), or earlier by a guest signing up (S11, dormant).

guest_merged.description: A guest signed in to an existing account and their Play data was merged into it (P3-W13-S07).

country_changed.description: A player set or removed their country on Profile (P3-W14-S03; owner, 2026-11-02). Saving the country they already have isn't one.

university_changed.description: A player set or removed their university on Profile (P3-W14-S03, ADR-0032): picked from the list (listed) or typed.

player_followed.description: A player followed another by username (P3-W14-S05, Q-P3-11). Following one already followed isn't one.

match_finished.description: A player's live match was finished or abandoned and its evidence applied (P3-W15-S05): emitted by the web app when it applies the worker's record, per player.

agent_task_started.description: The agent hook said a coding agent started a task (P3-W17-S04, §7): nothing about the task itself.

agent_task_finished.description: The agent hook said the task finished (P3-W17-S04, §7): how long it ran, and whether a place was saved.

match_found.description: Matchmaking paired the player for a live 1v1 (P3-W16-S02): how long they waited, for the Phase 3 time-to-match metric. Version 2 adds the opponent: a person, or a ghost or bot after the fallback or Play bot now (P3-W18-S03; owner, 2026-11-05).

concept_missed.description: A game or live match sent a miss back to reading (P3-W18-S03, §6.1): one per section to read again (a hand-written page has no item, so none), when the game finished or the match's evidence was applied. For the Phase 3 missed-concepts-read metric. Ids only.

pwa_installed.description: The app was installed as a PWA (W5-S06).

outbound_click.description: A link to a publisher's page was followed.
